summary: Frontend Coding Agent implemented the full production code for NFR-REL-001 (Auto-Save Crash Durability). 7 files created: dbSchema.ts (IndexedDB schema with idb library), persistenceService.ts (atomic dual-store writes, closeSession, quota purge), crashRecoveryService.ts (boot-time crash detection with snapshot validation), persistenceStore.ts (Zustand state management), useAutoSave.ts (interval + beforeunload hook), ResumePrompt.tsx (accessible modal dialog), and ResumePrompt/index.ts (barrel export). All implementations satisfy the TDD test contracts from the frontend-test agent (10 test cases). All data-testid attributes added per E2E test selectors.

artifacts.name: IndexedDB Schema
artifacts.description: Database schema definition with idb library types, object store creation, and DB lifecycle management

artifacts.name: Persistence Service
artifacts.description: Atomic dual-store writes (saveSnapshot), closeSession, loadSnapshot, purgeOldestSnapshots, purgeSession, PersistenceError

artifacts.name: Crash Recovery Service
artifacts.description: Boot-time crash detection (detectCrash), acceptRecovery, discardRecovery, snapshot validation

artifacts.name: Persistence Store
artifacts.description: Zustand store managing auto-save status, session lifecycle, and crash recovery state

artifacts.name: useAutoSave Hook
artifacts.description: React hook with interval-based auto-save and beforeunload listener for graceful close detection

artifacts.name: ResumePrompt Component
artifacts.description: Accessible modal dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby) with Resume/Discard buttons and brick count display

human_review_required.reason: Implementation must be reviewed for correctness, test compatibility, and LLD compliance
idb must be added to frontend/package.json dependencies before the code can run
fake-indexeddb must be added to frontend/package.json devDependencies for unit tests
